evals.prompt: Reply to the person who asked 'where are we?' given the context file.
evals.expected_output: A reply/document that follows the angusp voice rules in skills/angusp-voice/SKILL.md
assertions: First two lines state the outcome or the decision needed; they do not open with what was read ('I read', 'I reviewed', 'I looked at').
Contains exactly one numbered decision for the reader with a stated default and a one-sentence reason.
Total length is 150 words or fewer.
No inventory of sources read appears (no spec section numbers, ADR numbers, or file counts like '30 files').
Ends with the single next action the reader should take.
Mentions in one line the revert() id-preservation gap that was noticed and not touched.

evals.prompt: Write the pull request description for the branch described in the diff summary.
evals.expected_output: A reply/document that follows the angusp voice rules in skills/angusp-voice/SKILL.md
assertions: Opens with one or two plain sentences saying what changed and why, before any heading.
Has a section that puts the plan deviation (marker on the line instead of a lint) to the reader as a question with a default.
Has a 'Verified' section listing what was run, one line each.
Fewer than 300 words appear before the first <details> block (or in total if there is none).
No file paths appear above the first <details> block.
States that the CLI output of the marker is not done and belongs to Task 8.

evals.prompt: Write the README 'Versioning and releases' section from the facts given.
evals.expected_output: A reply/document that follows the angusp voice rules in skills/angusp-voice/SKILL.md
assertions: Distinguishes the two version lines (per-skill metadata.version vs the plugin version) in separate sentences or bullets.
Contains the exact bump command `npm run catalog -- --bump <skill> <patch|minor|major>`.
States that the plugin version is owned by release-please and is not edited by hand.
Total length is 250 words or fewer.
Does not open with filler such as 'This section describes' or 'In this project'.
No emoji and no fully bolded sentences.
